cowboy.line: When I was a young girl, well, I had me a cowboy
stanza: When I was a young girl, well, I had me a cowboy
He weren't much to look at, just a free ramblin' man
But that was a long time and no matter how I try
The years just flow by like a broken-down dam

cowboy.line: And I dreamed I was a cowboy
stanza: So I drank myself some whisky
And I dreamed I was a cowboy
And I rode across a border
California's my body
And your fire runs over me
My car broke down
In an old ghost town right around
Where they got James Dean
Emotional cowboy
With no hat and no boots
He stayed up all night
Trying to beat up the moon

cowboy.linePrev: When he shine with the nine, he's a rhinestone…

cowboy.line: She said I'm looking for a cowboy
stanza: She smiled at me
And I wondered why
She said I'm looking for a cowboy
To take me for a ride

playboy.line: Mom and Dad cut you off, huh, playboy?
stanza: Mom and Dad cut you off, huh, playboy?
Now y'all gotta get hitched. But hitchin' ties you down
You just wanna be free, hop from place to place
But freedom takes green
